newsitem.title: USA: Lexington Corporate buys three properties.
newsitem.headline: Lexington Corporate buys three properties.

text.p: Lexington Corporate Properties Inc said Friday it has acquired three industrial properties for about $14.7 million.
Two of the properties -- located in Plymouth, Mich., and Oberlin, Ohio -- were acquired for $11.3 million, and net-leased to Johnson Controls Inc for a term of 10 years.
The third property, in Franklin, N.C., was acquired for $3.4 million, and net-leased to SKF Bearings Ltd SKF USA for about 18 years.
The company said it expects to acquire another property in Tuscaloosa, Ala., for $2.86 million in January 1997 which would then be net-leased to Johnson Controls.
Lexington President and Chief Operating Officer T. Wilson Eglin said in a statement that the company expects it will have added about $100 million in assets by the end of 1996.
In 1997, the company expects to add at least $150 million in properties to its portfolio, Eglin said in a statement.
